text: The library will extend its opening hours during the exam week.
translation: 考试周期间图书馆将延长开放时间。

text: Many students take part-time jobs to pay for their living costs.
translation: 许多学生做兼职来支付生活费用。

text: Regular exercise can improve both your physical and mental health.
translation: 规律锻炼可以改善你的身心健康。

text: The new app allows users to track their daily study time.
translation: 这款新应用让用户可以记录每天的学习时间。

text: We should turn off the lights when we leave the classroom.
translation: 离开教室时我们应该关灯。

text: Online courses make it possible to learn anywhere at any time.
translation: 在线课程让随时随地学习成为可能。

text: The company plans to launch a new product next month.
translation: 公司计划下个月推出一款新产品。

text: Reading English newspapers is a good way to build vocabulary.
translation: 读英文报纸是积累词汇的好方法。

text: Please submit your application before the end of this week.
translation: 请在本周末之前提交你的申请。

text: The air quality has improved greatly since the factory moved away.
translation: 自从工厂搬走，空气质量大大改善。

text: She was so tired that she fell asleep as soon as she got home.
translation: 她太累了，一到家就睡着了。

text: If I had known the traffic was so heavy, I would have left earlier.
translation: 要是我知道堵车这么严重，我就会早点出发。

text: The teacher encouraged us to ask questions whenever we were unsure.
translation: 老师鼓励我们只要有疑问就提问。

text: More and more people choose to travel by high-speed train.
translation: 越来越多的人选择乘高铁出行。

text: It is important to protect your personal information online.
translation: 在网上保护个人信息很重要。

text: The meeting has been put off until next Tuesday afternoon.
translation: 会议已推迟到下周二下午。

text: He spends at least an hour practicing spoken English every day.
translation: 他每天至少花一小时练习英语口语。

text: The museum is free to visit on the first Sunday of each month.
translation: 博物馆每月第一个周日免费开放。

text: We are looking forward to hearing from you soon.
translation: 我们期待尽快收到您的回复。

text: Plastic waste has become a serious problem for the ocean.
translation: 塑料垃圾已成为海洋的严重问题。

text: Learning a foreign language takes patience and constant practice.
translation: 学一门外语需要耐心和持续的练习。

text: The restaurant offers a discount to customers who book online.
translation: 这家餐厅给在线预订的顾客打折。

text: She decided to major in computer science after graduation.
translation: 毕业后她决定主修计算机科学。

text: The government is taking measures to reduce air pollution.
translation: 政府正在采取措施减少空气污染。

text: Please keep quiet in the reading room and turn off your phone.
translation: 请在阅览室保持安静并关闭手机。

text: This course is designed for students with little programming experience.
translation: 这门课是为几乎没有编程经验的学生设计的。

text: The number of volunteers has increased over the past few years.
translation: 过去几年志愿者人数有所增加。

text: He apologized for being late and promised to come earlier next time.
translation: 他为迟到道歉，并保证下次早点来。

text: Remember to back up your files before you update the system.
translation: 更新系统前记得备份你的文件。

text: The report shows that young people are spending more time online.
translation: 报告显示年轻人花在上网的时间更多了。
